note: Legal maximums and statutory rates for Turkish lira credit cards. Banks may charge less; a rate printed on the statement wins over this file, and a user override in settings wins over both. Amounts are in kuruş.

interest.basis: Monthly rate on the unpaid balance for the actual days from one cut-off date to the next, divided by 30 (TCMB/BDDK practice, see the bank example). Not compounded inside a cycle.

sets.verified: Rates of the row before 1/12/2026 in the TCMB table, as quoted by the press on 2026-11-24; the start date of this row is not checked.
TCMB table row 1/12/2026 (announced 2026-11-24); tiers: debt under 30.000 TL, 30.000-180.000 TL, over 180.000 TL.

taxes_on_interest.source: Gider Vergileri Kanunu (Law 6802) art. 28-33 for BSMV, https://www.mevzuat.gov.tr/mevzuatmetin/1.4.6802.pdf; KKDF under Council of Ministers Decision 88/12944 as amended, https://www.resmigazete.gov.tr/
taxes_on_interest.verified: Both 15% of the interest amount for individual credit cards per bank tariffs and secondary sources checked 2026-11-25; the official decision text was not opened. Override in settings if your statement shows otherwise.

sets.verified: BDDK Board Decision 11581 of 2026-10-01 (Banka Kartları ve Kredi Kartları Hakkında Yönetmelik art. 22/7): limit threshold raised from 50.000 TL to 100.000 TL.
BDDK Board Decision 11605 of 2026-11-19 as reported by several newspapers on 2026-11-20; the decision text on bddk.org.tr was not opened and the date banks apply it from is not confirmed.

minimum_payment.note: The ratio applies to the statement total (dönem borcu); the tier is chosen by the card limit. A minimum printed on the statement wins for that statement.

due_date.holiday_rule: When the due date is a weekend day or public holiday, banks accept payment on the next business day without interest (common bank practice; check your card agreement).
due_date.source: Banka Kartları ve Kredi Kartları Hakkında Yönetmelik (RG 10.03.2007, 26458), https://www.mevzuat.gov.tr/

example_document: DenizBank public tariff 'Akdi ve Gecikme Faizi Hesaplama Örnekleri': 1.000 TL debt, 20% minimum paid, 800 TL unpaid at 1,98% for 10 + 20 days gives 5,28 + 10,56 = 15,84 TL interest (before BSMV and KKDF).
